TextView.android:text: Wombat Liberates needs Android Accessibility access so it can read the Kindle page currently on screen. When Android opens Accessibility settings, scroll down to Wombat Liberates, tap it, then turn on Allow.

Tap Start Kindle scan, enter the book title, then open Kindle at the first page you want. Each scan becomes a new book in Your books. The scan stops by itself at the end of the book. If it stopped early, tap the book in Your books and choose Continue scanning this book. To check everything works first, run a short Test scan from Advanced settings. You can also import an existing text file instead.

Kindle must stay open and visible on your screen for the entire scan. Wombat Liberates reads each Kindle page as it appears; switching to another app, locking the phone, or using the phone for something else interrupts the scan.

Each screen takes about 1.5 seconds, so a long book can take 30 minutes or more. Connect your phone to power and leave Kindle on screen. If Kindle will not turn a page, or a page looks like a table, the phone buzzes and a small panel asks what to do. A phone call pauses the scan until the call ends and you are back in Kindle; notification banners are waited out so they never end up in the book. For fewer interruptions, turn on Do Not Disturb while scanning in Advanced settings. Set Pages with tables to Keep or Skip in Advanced settings for unattended scans.

When a scan finishes, the review screen opens; you can reopen it any time by tapping the book in Your books. Text is cleaned on your phone automatically, including removing Kindle footer text, and given a quality rating. View, compare and save any version as text or EPUB. Pictures from the book are saved too and shown as thumbnails, where you can delete them or choose the cover; near the start of a new scan you are asked whether a picture is the cover. To fix the remaining OCR slips (like "er" for "her"), tap Clean on server: the book is sent once to your Wombat Cleanup server, which proofreads it with AI while your phone is free, and you get a notification when the cleaned version is ready to compare. Add the server address and key under Advanced settings first. Raw OCR is never changed.

Tap a book in Your books and choose Save EPUB to Documents. It is saved to Documents/Wombat Liberates, using the version chosen in Review (device cleanup unless you pick another); save again after changing the text to update it. Open in EPUB reader sends the book straight to your reader app, such as Wombat Reader. Headings such as CHAPTER SIX become entries in the table of contents.

Screenshots are OCRed locally and discarded. Text remains on your phone unless you choose Clean on server, which sends the book only to your own Wombat Cleanup server and is deleted there once the phone downloads the result.
